hooks.name: Project Context on Session Start
hooks.description: Injects project context at the start of every session so Kiro immediately knows what this project is about.

action.prompt:
You are working on LivestockGuard — a full-stack GPS livestock tracking and geofencing platform for South African farmers. Key context:

ARCHITECTURE: 4-layer system (Devices → Infrastructure → Cloud Backend → User Interfaces)
TECH STACK: Python 3.12 (FastAPI), TypeScript (React 18 + Vite), Rust (Tokio), C11 (Zephyr RTOS)
SERVICES: API Gateway (:8000), MQTT Writer, Alert Engine, Analytics Engine, Ingestion (Rust), Geofence Engine (Rust)
INFRA: PostgreSQL+TimescaleDB (:5432), Redis (:6379), EMQX MQTT (:1883), Docker Compose
FRONTEND: Dashboard (React + MapLibre GL, :5173), Mobile (React Native + Expo, :8082)
FARMS: Boschhoek (Free State, GPS collars), Loch Vaal (Gauteng, BLE gateway), Sibanyoni (North West, 50 cattle BLE)
COMMANDS: Use `make help` for all targets. Key: `make start`, `make demo-full`, `make test`, `make dashboard`
TESTING: pytest for Python services (in-memory SQLite), cargo test for Rust, tsc+vite build for dashboard
CI: GitHub Actions — all 5 jobs must pass before merge to main.

Read the steering docs in .kiro/steering/ for detailed patterns when working on specific file types.
